## Topics
- Working with multiple data frames
- left_join(), inner_join(), anti_join()
- pivot_longer() and pivot_wider()
- Calculating rates per population

## Learning objectives
By the end of this week you should be able to:

- Choose the right join for a question
- Reshape between long and wide formats
- Join case counts to population to compute incidence rates

## Data
WHO tuberculosis data (`tidyr::who2`, `tidyr::population`)
